skill.summary: Scrape and analyze active Google, Meta, and TikTok ads from competitors to extract winning creatives, copy, spend signals, and recreate them for your campaigns.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — launch of the Google & Meta Ads Spy Tool for deep, automated competitor ad intelligence.

- Instantly scrapes all active competitor ads across Meta, Google, and TikTok.
- Detects spend signals to surface only proven, long-running ad winners.
- Analyzes hooks, formats, angles, CTAs, landing pages, and spend duration for each ad.
- Uses Claude AI to rewrite top-performing ads in your brand’s voice and create multiple angle variations.
- Optionally generates fresh video ads from winning creatives using InVideo AI.
- Outputs a complete swipe file: spy summary, competitor ads, niche intelligence, and a ready-to-execute campaign strategy.
